# Flowiseai

FlowiseAI is an open-source generative AI development platform for building AI Agents and LLM workflows.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/flowiseai/.

## Actions

- **Clone Chatflow**: Clone an existing chatflow.
- **Create Chatflow**: Create a new chatflow in FlowiseAI.
- **Delete Chat Messages**: Delete chat messages for a specific chatflow.
- **Delete Chatflow**: Delete a chatflow by its ID.
- **Delete Tool By ID**: Delete a specific FlowiseAI tool by ID.
- **Export Chatflow** (read-only): Export a chatflow by its ID.
- **Get All Chatflows** (read-only): Retrieve all chatflows.
- **Get Single Chatflow** (read-only): Retrieve a chatflow by its ID.
- **Get Tool By ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific FlowiseAI tool by its ID.
- **Import Chatflow**: Import a chatflow from an exported JSON file.
- **List All Tools** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all tools.
- **List Chat Messages** (read-only): List chat messages of a chatflow.
- **Update Chatflow Details**: Update details of an existing chatflow.
- **Update Tool By ID**: Update a specific tool by its ID.
